errors.what: First pack-html run produced a WRONG human/index.html: instead of my authored pitch view it emitted an auto-generated 'Document Data / Recent Decisions' template (1848 chars) with stale {{budget_eur}} placeholders from the parent. The pinned decision and new schema landed correctly, but my full pitch HTML body was discarded.
errors.recovered_by: Re-running the IDENTICAL pack-html command (same inputs, same output path) produced the correct authored pitch view (3493 chars, 'Investment Ask'/'Why Halo'/'120,000' present, no template). Confirmed non-deterministic: bisection tests A-E with the same inputs to temp outputs all packed the custom HTML correctly. Final committed artifact is correct and validates OK.

problems_and_friction: 1) clan pack-html appears FLAKY when --schema override + YAML frontmatter are combined: the first run silently fell back to an auto-generated template view and dropped the authored HTML body (no error, no warning, validate said OK). Only a re-run fixed it. This is a data-loss-class risk because the failure is silent. 2) Frontmatter data keys (recommended_concept, pitch_ask_eur) did NOT merge into shared/data.yaml on either run — shared data still carries only inherited parent keys, while the new schema declares fields the data lacks; clan validate still returns OK so there is no schema-vs-data enforcement. Frontmatter's only durable effect was recording the pinned decision entry. 3) cwd resets to the spawn subdir (test-sandbox/happy/heavy) between bash calls, and 'clan data' is not a subcommand (use export-static / read human / unzip). 4) 'clan render' materialises to disk and prints a hint rather than emitting HTML to stdout; 'clan read human' applies token-filtering so its char count understates the real view size — had to unzip the .clan to verify ground truth.
context_understood: Hop 3 of 3 (final) of a metamorphosis chain: each hop re-views the SAME .clan lineage into a new schema/HTML without re-passing --assets or re-transcribing prior data. Parent hop-02 (concept-deck) -> hop-03 (client pitch). Assets (logo-mark.svg, doc.clan, doc-fresh.clan) and prior shared data carried through automatically via the parent reference. Authored a client-pitch HTML recommending concept 'Halo' with a 120,000 EUR ask, applied a 2-field schema, recorded a pinned pitch-lead decision, and validated. Decision chain correctly shows all three hops (account-planner -> creative-director -> pitch-lead).
